title: Staining and Dehydration of 10 Micron Rat Heart Sections
author: Shaina Robbins
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.webfban
materials: Submerge slide into 0.1% Cresyl Violet for 00:05:00
Gently rinse slide by dipping into H2O 10 times EMD Millipore™ Ultrapure Water for Molecular Biology Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #09-739-011

Gently dip slide 2 times into Xylene Xylenes histological grade Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #534056-4L Flammable liquids (Category 3), H226 Acute toxicity, Inhalation (Category 4), H332 Skin irritation (Category 2), H315 Eye irritation (Category 2A), H319 Carcinogenicity (Category 2), H351

Submerge slide into Xylene for 00:00:20 Xylenes histological grade Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #534056-4L Flammable liquids (Category 3), H226 Acute toxicity, Inhalation (Category 4), H332 Skin irritation (Category 2), H315 Eye irritation (Category 2A), H319 Carcinogenicity (Category 2), H351

steps.title: Prepare slide for processing
steps.instruction: Remove the slide from the -80 °C freezer, keep it covered, and allow it to reach room temperature for 00:01:00 or until the frost dissipates.

steps.title: Perform cold acetone wash
steps.instruction: Submerge the slide into cold acetone (kept in -20 °C freezer) for 00:00:15.

steps.title: Wash with PBS
steps.instruction: Gently dip the slide 10 times into 1x PBS (Catalog #BP2438-4) until the OCT appears to be washed off.

steps.title: Dehydrate with ethanol
steps.instruction: Perform a graded ethanol dehydration series on the slide.

substeps.instruction: Dip and agitate the slide 2 times into 95% EtOH
Dip and agitate the slide 2 times into 100% EtOH (200 Proof, Decon Labs Catalog #2716)
Submerge the slide into 100% EtOH (200 Proof, Decon Labs Catalog #2716) for 00:00:15

steps.title: Dry slide
steps.instruction: Allow the slide to dry under a chemical fume hood for 00:05:00 before proceeding to LCM/LMD.
